rv.q: All the same, the rhyme-heavy songs are catchy, giving plenty of opportunity for punchy choral routines.

As a piece of theatre for an adult audience that nonetheless fills you with the joy of the season, the Royal Exchange's offering hits all the right notes and is a perfect way to spend an evening at the theatre at this time of year.
Thankfully this is a production that has all the fizz and pizazz of freshly popped champagne...
Josh Seymour's production is an appropriately gaudy fever dream... Frivolity dominates; this play scrimps on pathos.
Overall I thoroughly enjoyed this musical.

cn.t: Critics praise this vibrant revival of the Viv Nicholson musical, celebrating its dazzling silver design, energetic performances, and compelling dual-timeline storytelling that brings the pools winner's rags-to-riches-to-rags tale to life.
